questions.question: Three salesmen named X, Y and Z sell 268 phones during a week. X sells 12 phones less than Z. Y sells half the number of phones sold by Z. If a total of 268 phones have been sold during the week, how many phones has salesman Z sold?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

X + Y + Z = 268

X sells 12 phones less than Z

X = Z – 12

Y sells half the number of phones sold by Z

Y = Z/ 2

Substituting ‘X’ and ‘Y’ in ‘X + Y + Z = 268’

Z – 12 + Z/ 2 + Z = 268

2Z – 24 + Z + 2Z /2 = 268

5Z – 24 = 536

5Z = 560

Z = 112

Salesman ‘Z’ sold 112 phones.

Hence, “112” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The age of Gopal is one third of his grandfather’s age. The age of his grandmother is 6years less than his grandfather. If the total of the ages of all three persons is 113 years.

What is the age of the grandmother?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Gopal be X

Let his grandmother’s age be Y

Let his grandfather’s age be Z

Given,

Age of Gopal is one third of his grandfather’s age

X = Z /3

The age of his grandmother is 6years less than his grandfather

Y = Z – 6

Given,

X + Y + Z = 113

Z/3 + Z – 6 + Z = 113

7Z – 18 = 339

7Z = 357

Z = 51

Age of Gopal’s grandfather is 51

His grandmother’s age is 6 years less than his grandfather.

So,

His grandmother’s age is 45

Hence, “45” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III.

Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some surgeons are doctors.

All doctors are experts.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some experts are surgeons.

II. No expert is surgeon.

III. Some experts are doctors.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6d439a6cabcfe42f43afa728e88cc767128732f090d649edc06b33b87388cc3.png] 

Conclusion 1: Some experts are surgeons → True (This is definitely true)

Conclusion 2: No expert is surgeon → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion 3: Some experts are doctors → True (This is definitely true)

Hence, “only conclusion 1 and conclusion 3” follow.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III.

Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some hens are cranes.

Some cranes are ducks.

**Conclusions:**

I. No hen is duck.

II. Some ducks are cranes.

III. Some hens are ducks.

options.text: Conclusion II and either I or III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Conclusion I and either II or III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a4b7044c16adaa4be3791094cd9a4cf49608d8919717722d784aa721ec5d5c7.png] 

Conclusion 1 : No hen is duck → False (This is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 2 : Some ducks are cranes → True (This is definitely true)

Conclusion 3 : Some hens are ducks → False (This is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 1 and conclusion 3 form complementary pair.

Hence, “Conclusion 2 and either 1 or 3” follow.

questions.question: ‘March’ is related to ‘third’ in the same way as ‘October’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
March is the third month in a year.

Similarly,

October is the tenth month in a year.

Hence, “tenth” is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Mamba’ is related to ‘snake’ in the same way as ‘________’ is related to ‘bird’.
questions.solution:
Mamba is a highly venomous African snake.

Similarly,

Eagle is a bird.

Hence, “eagle” is the correct answer.
